ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: P1 and P2 plants of a certain diploid plant are crossed to obtain F1, and F1 is self-crossed to obtain F2. PCR detection is performed on the DNA of individuals, and the electrophoresis results of the products are shown in the figure, where ①～⑧ are some F2 individuals. The upper 2 bands are amplification products of a pair of allelic genes, and the lower 2 bands are amplification products of another pair of allelic genes. These 2 pairs of allelic genes are located on non-homologous chromosomes. Answer the question: How many bands are there in the PCR product electrophoresis result of another type of F2 individual?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: P1 and P2 plants of a certain diploid plant are crossed to obtain F1, and F1 is self-crossed to obtain F2. PCR detection is performed on the DNA of individuals, and the electrophoresis results of the products are shown in the figure, where ①～⑧ are some F2 individuals. The upper 2 bands are amplification products of a pair of allelic genes, and the lower 2 bands are amplification products of another pair of allelic genes. These 2 pairs of allelic genes are located on non-homologous chromosomes. Answer the question: How many bands are there in the PCR product electrophoresis result of another type of F2 individual?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the electrophoresis figure, the lanes are P1, P2, F1, and F2 individuals ①～⑧ in order. P1 shows 1 band in each of the upper allelic-gene region and the lower allelic-gene region; P2 also shows 1 band in each region, but the positions are complementary to those of P1. In F1, both possible upper bands and both possible lower bands all appear, that is, there are 4 bands in total. Among the F2 lanes ①～⑧, different combinations can be seen; some lanes have 2 bands, some have 3 bands, and some have 4 bands. Then reason: Denote the two possible upper bands as A1 and A2, and the two possible lower bands as B1 and B2. When each locus is homozygous, PCR electrophoresis shows 1 band, and when heterozygous, it shows 2 bands. Because P1 and P2 are complementary, F1 is heterozygous at both pairs of allelic genes; F1 self-crosses, and the two pairs of allelic genes are located on non-homologous chromosomes, so the genotype combinations at the two loci in F2 total 3×3=9 types. The figure has already given 8 of these electrophoretic combinations in ①～⑧, leaving one type not shown. The remaining combination belongs to the type in which one locus is homozygous and the other locus is heterozygous, so the number of bands is 1+2=3 bands.
